question: Does C0 (128x9, lr 1e-4) learn weak-label signal beyond what a shuffled-label control shows, and does gradient clipping at 5.0 differ from 1.0?

holdout_pool.description: v0.1.0 manifest studies NOT in the 1,200 selection; never trained or validated on in Phases 14-15 (they appeared in the larger Phase 9-13 runs, so this is not independent data)

per_run.report_epoch: final (fixed in advance; no selection on validation or hold-out)

criteria.C1_validation: real final macro AUC minus shuffled twin >= 0.10
criteria.C2_holdout: real hold-out macro AUC minus shuffled twin hold-out macro AUC >= 0.05 (final-epoch checkpoint)
criteria.C3_loss: real final validation loss < constant-prediction floor (p=0.5) of that split
criteria.C4_control_sanity: mean over seeds of shuffled validation macro AUC and of shuffled hold-out macro AUC both within [0.45, 0.55]; otherwise verdict is invalid_control and the run is investigated, not interpreted
criteria.supported: C1, C2 and C3 each hold in 5 of 5 seeds (arm evaluated separately)
criteria.promising: C1, C2 and C3 each hold in at least 4 of 5 seeds
criteria.incomplete: fewer than 5 complete seed blocks: report descriptively, no verdict
criteria.clip_comparison: different only if the sign of (clip 5.0 minus clip 1.0 real final validation AUC) is the same in 5 of 5 seeds and the mean magnitude >= 0.03

stopping_rules.non_finite_loss: abort the run and stop the experiment
stopping_rules.time: no seed block is started if it cannot finish before 6900 s of kernel time; kernel limit 7200 s
stopping_rules.control_alarm: if a shuffled run reaches validation AND hold-out macro AUC >= 0.60, stop and investigate leakage

forbidden: any choice of epoch, seed or arm made after seeing results
validity_note: Alternative splits of the same 1,200 studies are not an independent external validation set; the hold-out pool is disjoint from this experiment's training/validation studies but comes from the same source, labeler and earlier phases.
